comment: HD graphics (docs/HD-GRAPHICS.md): the openciv2-assets runtime art pack, pinned. Upgrading = changing tag, url, sha256 and size here. tools/fetch_hd_pack.py downloads it, checks this checksum and installs it in data/native/hd (not in the repository); the game's opening window downloads it the same way (src/host/host_launcher.c, built with these values) into the user's own folder. pack_sha256 and pack_size: data/atlas-hd.pack inside it (as its package.json lists), for the browser version, which also takes the pack alone (src/web/hdpack.js).
